title: The Red Sled Ride
description: A climb, three bumps, and a warm cup of cocoa.
subtitle: Shane and Dad climb the snowy hill for one wonderful ride.

cover.alt: Alex and Shane flying down the snowy hill together on their bright red sled.

blocks.html: Snow covered the path, the trees, and the little bench at the bottom of the hill. Shane wore his red coat and pom-pom hat. Dad pulled their red sled by its rope.
“This hill looks bigger in snow,” Shane said. They climbed together. Halfway up, Shane stopped to catch his breath. Dad stopped too. “We have plenty of time,” he said.

blocks.alt: Alex and 5-year-old Shane bundled up in colorful warm puffy snowsuits pulling their bright red sled up a snowy hill with pine trees.
blocks.caption: Shane and Dad pull the red sled up the hill.

blocks.html: At the top, Shane brushed snow from the sled. Dad sat behind him. Shane tucked his mittens around the sides. “Ready?” Dad asked. Shane gave a serious nod.

🗣️ Say it with Shane

Ready, set... whoosh!
Dad gave the sled a push. Down they went.

The first bump made Shane bounce. “One!” The second made Dad’s hat slip over one eye. “Two!” On the third bump, the sled lifted for a tiny moment, then landed in soft snow. “Three!” they shouted together.

blocks.alt: Alex and Shane flying down the snowy hill together on the red sled, laughing with snow spraying high into the air.
blocks.caption: The red sled flies down the snowy hill.

blocks.html: The sled slid into a drift and stopped. Snow flew over their boots. Shane lay back and looked at the white sky. Then he laughed so hard Dad started laughing too.
“Again?” Shane asked. Dad looked up at the long hill. “After we warm up.”

🗣️ Say it with Shane

One, two, three!
They made snow angels beside the sled. Shane’s angel had small wings. Dad’s was so big that one wing touched the path.
On the bench, Dad opened a thermos of cocoa. Shane held his cup with both mittens. A marshmallow floated on top. After one sip, a white smudge sat above his lip.

blocks.alt: Shane laughing with a funny white marshmallow foam mustache sitting wrapped in a warm blanket beside Alex who holds a thermos of hot cocoa.
blocks.caption: Cocoa tastes even better after a snowy ride.

blocks.html: Dad pointed to his own mouth. Shane wiped the wrong side of his face. Dad laughed and helped him find it.
The hill was quiet now. They watched the last sledders head home. “We can ride again tomorrow,” Dad said. Shane leaned against him and took one more warm sip.

🗣️ Say it with Shane

Tomorrow.
